## 1000 - 1099

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1000 - Calculation validation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01000">

Calculation validation (CV) exceptions will be generated when a data point needed for calculations is either not provided or goes outside of the acceptable limits for a calculation to occur. These limits are hard-coded within FLOWCAL.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1001 CV - Static pressure not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01001">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a non-zero DP or pulses value is given but static pressure is not provided, this exception will be generated.

For example: If a gas orifice periodic record is imported with differential pressure = 65 but static pressure is not available, then FLOWCAL will generate this exception; however, if gas orifice periodic record is imported with differential pressure = 0 and static pressure is not available, this exception will not be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1002 CV - Static pressure too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01002">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a static pressure value is provided that is greater than 20,000 PSI, this exception will be generated.

For example: If a gas orifice periodic record is imported with a static pressure value of 25,000 PSI, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01003">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01003">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a differential pressure value is provided that is greater than 1,500 inches of water, this exception will be generated.

For example: If a gas orifice periodic record is imported with a differential pressure value of 2,000, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1004 CV - Differential pressure too low or negative</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01004">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the cutoff alarm limit is not set and a differential pressure value is provided that is less than 0 inches of water, this exception will be generated.

For example: If a gas orifice meter does not have the cutoff alarm limit set and a periodic record is imported with a differential pressure value of 0, his exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1005 CV - Static pressure too low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01005">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. This exception will be generated if Differential Pressure is greater than 0.001 and the Static Pressure value provided is less than:

- The Minimum Pressure Limit set in System Configuration; or

<!-- -->

- 1 PSIA if the Minimum Pressure Limit in System Configuration is not set.

For example, if the Minimum Pressure Liming set in System Configuration is null and a Gas Orifice periodic record is imported with a Differential Pressure of 50 Inches of Water and a Static Pressure of 0.95 PSIA, then this exception will be generated; however, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is imported with a Differential Pressure of 0 Inches of Water and a Static Pressure of 0.95 PSIA, then this exception will not be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1006 CV - Flow time too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01006">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a Flow Time value is provided that is greater than 74400 and the option on the Calculations tab in the Meter Editor "Ignore Bogus Pulses" is disabled, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is manually entered with a Flow Time of 75000, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01007">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01007">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a non-zero Differential Pressure or Pulses is given and a Temperature value is provided that is less than -459.68°F, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is imported with a Differential Pressure of 50 Inches of Water and a Temperature of -460°F, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01008">

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a temperature value is provided that is greater than 400°F, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is imported with a Temperature of 450 F, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01009">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01010">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1010 CV - Volume &gt; 0 but no differential pressure, or differential pressure is less than low flow cutoff</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01010">

This exception applies to imported gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. This exception will be generated if:

- Volume is greater than 0; and
- The differential pressure is:
  - Not provided; or
  - Less than the value specified for the Low Flow Cutoff alarm in Meter Characteristics; or
  - Less than the value specified for the Exception Value Low Flow Cutoff in System Configuration

For example, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is imported with a Volume of 1000 but Differential Pressure is null, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01011">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1011 CV - Volume &gt; 0 but no pulses</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01011">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the option on the Calculations tab in the Meter Editor "Ignore Bogus Pulses" is disabled, Volume is greater than 0, and Pulses are between -0.00001 and 0.00001, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Turbine periodic record is imported with a Volume of 1000 and Pulses of 0, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01012">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01012">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the pressure base value configured on the meter is less than 1 psi or is not provided, this exception will be generated and the calculation will stop.

For example: If a gas orifice is configured with a pressure base of 0.13 psi and a periodic record is imported, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01013">

For example, if a gas orifice is configured with a pressure base of 101.325 psi and a periodic record is imported, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01018">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01020">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1020 CV - Beta ratio too small</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01020">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a valid Pipe and Plate Diameter is given and the Beta Ratio calculated is less than the Beta Ratio Min Limit defined in System Configuration (or 0.1 if limit is not defined), then this exception will be generated.

The Pipe Diameter must be within the minimum and maximum limits for this exception to be generated. The minimum limit is 0.1 Inches and the maximum limit is 40 Inches.

For example, the Beta Ratio Min Limit in System Configuration is set to 0.1 and a Gas Orifice meter is configured as follows:

- Pipe Diameter = 10 in
- Plate Diameter = 0.125 in
- Calculated Beta Ratio = 0.0125

This exception will be generated on all flow data that is imported or edited with this configuration.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01021">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1021 CV - Beta ratio too large</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01021">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a valid Pipe and Plate Diameter is given and the Beta Ratio calculated is greater than the Beta Ratio Max Limit defined in System Configuration (or 0.75 if limit is not defined), then this exception will be generated.

The Pipe Diameter must be within the minimum and maximum limits for this exception to be generated. The minimum limit is 0.1 Inches and the maximum limit is 40 Inches.

For example, the Beta Ratio Max Limit in System Configuration is set to 0.75 and a Gas Orifice meter is configured as follows:

- Pipe Diameter = 10 in
- Plate Diameter = 8 in
- Calculated Beta Ratio = 0.8

This exception will be generated on all flow data that is imported or edited with this configuration.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01036">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01037">

For example, if a Gas Orifice is configured with the “Calc from Raw Volume” set to No, a K-Factor of 0, and aperiodic record is imported, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01038">

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the meter is configured with a Meter Factor that is less than or equal to 0, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Orifice is configured with a Meter Factor of 0 and periodic record is created, then this exception will be generated.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01040">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01040">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Measured Heating Value on the meter analysis is not provided or outside of the Heating Value limits, then this exception will be generated.

The Heating Value limits are as follows:

- Minimum Heating Value = 0.01
- Maximum Heating Value = 12000.1

For example, if a Gas Orifice periodic record is created and Heating Value is left null, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01041">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1041 CV - Differential pressure not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01041">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data for meters using an AGA-3 calculation method.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Differential Pressure is not provided, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <span id="1042"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01042">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1042 CV - Differential &gt; 0 but no volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01042">

This exception applies to imported gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a Differential Pressure value is imported that is greater than the cutoff limit but Volume is between -0.00001 and 0.00001, then this exception will be generated.

The cutoff limit for Differential Pressure is defined using the following precedence:

- Cutoff limit defined on the Ranges tab in Meter Characteristics
- Low Flow Cut-Off defined in System Configuration
- 0.00001

For example, with the cutoff limits within FLOWCAL defined as follows:

- Meter Characteristics Cutoff = 0.75
- System Configuration Low Flow Cut-Off = 0.5

A Gas Orifice periodic record imported with a Volume of 0 and a Differential Pressure of 0.6 will not generate this exception because the Differential Pressure is lower than the Meter Characteristics Cutoff. A Gas Orifice periodic record imported with a Volume of 0.000001 and a Differential Pressure of 1 will cause this exception to be generated because the Differential Pressure is higher than the Meter Characteristics Cutoff and Volume is between -0.00001 and 0.00001.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01043">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1043 CV - Pulses &gt; 0 but no volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01043">

This exception applies to imported gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the option in the Meter Editor “Ignore Bogues Pulses” is disabled and a periodic record is imported with Pulses greater than 0 but Volume is 0, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas Turbine periodic record is imported with a Volume of 0 and Pulses of 1000, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <span id="1044"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01044">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1044 CV - Volume &gt; 0 but differential pressure less than cutoff alarm</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01044">

This exception applies to imported gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a Differential Pressure value is imported that is less than the cutoff limit but Volume is greater than 0, then this exception will be generated.

The cutoff limit for Differential Pressure is defined using the following precedence:

- Cutoff limit defined on the Ranges tab in Meter Characteristics
- Low Flow Cut-Off defined in System Configuration
- 0.00001

For example, with the cutoff limits within FLOWCAL defined as follows:

- Meter Characteristics Cutoff = 0.75
- System Configuration Low Flow Cut-Off = 0.5

A Gas Orifice periodic record imported with a Volume of 1000 and a Differential Pressure of 0.6 will generate this exception because the Differential Pressure is less than the Meter Characteristics Cutoff and Volume is greater than 0. A Gas Orifice periodic record imported with a Volume of 1000 and a Differential Pressure of 1 will not generate this exception because the Differential Pressure is higher than the Meter Characteristics Cutoff.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01045">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1045 CV - Relative density too low for AGA calculation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01045">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the relative density on the meter analysis is less than the minimum relative density limit for the AGA calculation to occur, then this exception will be generated.

The minimum relative density limits are as follows:

- AGA-8 NX-19: 0.554
- AGA-8 Gross 1 & 2: 0.56
- All other Fpv Methods: 0.067

For example: If a Gas Orifice is configured to use the Fpv Method AGA-8 Detail and a periodic record is created with a Relative Density of 0.05, then this exception will be generated because it is less than the minimum relative density limit of 0.067.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01046">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1046 CV - Relative density too high for AGA calculation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01046">

This exception applies to imported and edited gas flow data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the relative density on the meter analysis is greater than the maximum relative density limit for the AGA calculation to occur, then this exception will be generated.

The maximum relative density limits are as follows:

- AGA-8 NX-19: 0.75
- AGA-8 Gross 1 & 2: 0.87
- All other Fpv Methods: 1.99

For example: If a gas orifice is configured to use the Fpv Method AGA-8 Detail and a periodic record is created with a Relative Density of 2.05, then this exception will be generated because it is greater than the maximum relative density limit of 1.99.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01047">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1047 CV - Flowmeter coefficient not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01047">

This exception applies to Gas Meters configured with a Meter Type of Cone. If Flow Coefficient defined on the Meter tab of Meter Characteristics in the Volume Editor is not provided or is less than 0, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01048">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1048 CV - Calculated raw volume does not match expected raw volume (Type P)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01048">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data using a Calculation Method of AGA-7 or Line Pack.

For meters configured with a Calculation Method of AGA-7, this exception will generate when the absolute value of the difference between the provided Raw Volume and the FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume (\|provided Raw Volume – calculated Raw Volume\|) is greater than the maximum difference allowed.

The maximum difference allowed is as follows:

| Provided Raw Volume | Maximum Difference Allowed |
|:-------------------:|:--------------------------:|
|       \< 100        |             2              |
|       \< 1000       |             20             |
|      \< 10000       |            200             |
|      \> 10000       |            500             |

For example, a Gas Turbine is configured with a Calculation Method of AGA-7 and periodic record is created with Pulses = 1000, K Factor = 1, and Raw Volume = 1050. The FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume = 1000 (Pulses / K Factor). The maximum difference allowed is 200 because the provided Raw Volume is greater than 1000 but less than 10000. The absolute value of the difference is 50 (\|1050-1000\|), which is less than the maximum difference allowed, so this exception will not be generated.

However, if the K Factor was imported as 10, then the FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume = 100 (Pulses / K Factor). The absolute value of the difference is 950 (\|1050-100\|), which is greater than the maximum difference allowed, so this exception will be generated.

For meters configured with a Calculation Method of Line Pack, this exception will generate when the Percent Difference between the provided Raw Volume and the FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume exceeds the Max Deviation on the Validations \> Flowing Parameters tab in the Meter Editor.

The Max Deviation Type must be set to Percent.

Percent Difference is calculated as:

\|Calculated Raw Volume – Provided Raw Volume\| / Provided Raw Volume

For example, a Line Pack Meter has the Max Deviation set to 10 Percent in the Meter Editor and is configured with a Pipe Diameter of 24 Inches and Pipe Length of 28 Miles. The FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume ≈ 464 MCF (V = π\*r\*h\*unit conversions). A record is created that has Raw Volume = 550. The Percent Difference ≈ 15.6%, which is greater than the Max Deviation, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01049">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1049 CV - Pipe length too small</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01049">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data on Line Pack meters.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a Line Pack meter is configured with a Pipe Length that is less than 0, or is left null, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01050">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1050 CV - Calculated raw volume does not match expected raw volume (Type U)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01050">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data using a Calculation Method of Line Pack.

For meters configured with a Calculation Method of Line Pack, this exception will generate when the Unit Difference between the provided Raw Volume and the FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume exceeds the Max Deviation on the Validations \> Flowing Parameters tab in the Meter Editor.

The Max Deviation Type must be set to Unit.

Unit Difference is calculated as:

\|Calculated Raw Volume – Provided Raw Volume\|

For example, a Line Pack Meter has the Max Deviation set to 10 Units in the Meter Editor and is configured with a Pipe Diameter of 24 Inches and Pipe Length of 28 Miles. The FLOWCAL calculated Raw Volume ≈ 464 MCF (V = π\*r\*h\*unit conversions). A record is created that has Raw Volume = 500. The Unit Difference ≈ 36, which is greater than the Max Deviation, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01051">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1051 CV - Sediment water volume not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01051">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

This exception will generate when the following criteria is met:

- The Product on the Flow Data record has the option “Generate Exceptions for unavailable S&W% and CSW” enabled on the Product tab in the Product Editor; and
- The Flow Data record created is missing S&W Volume, S&W%, and CSW

For example, if a Liquid Coriolis is configured with a Crude Product that has the option “Generate Exceptions for unavailable S&W% and CSW” enabled and periodic record is created with no value provided for S&W Volume, S&W%, and CSW, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01052">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1052 CV - Water density not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01052">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Water Density is not configured on the System that the Meter is a member of, then this exception will be generated on each flow data record that is created.

The Water Density is configured in System Factors (Admin \> System Options \> System Factors).

</div>

#### 1053 CV - Base temperature not allowable (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01054">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1054 CV - Fluid type not allowable</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01054">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data that is configured with a Calculation Method other than Data Only.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If a flow data record is created that does not have a Product defined, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01055">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1055 CV - Density meter factor (DMF) not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01055">

The exception applies to imported and edited Meter Data for all Meters other than Liquid Line Pack meters, as well as the following Ticket Types: Meter, Flare, Blow Down, and Product Conversion.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Pyc Factor (DMF) is not configured, or is less than or equal to 0, on the Meter Characteristic, then this exception will be generated on each flow data record that is created.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01056">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1056 CV - Alternate density low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01056">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If an Observed Density value is provided that is less than the Alternate Density Lower Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Alternate Density Lower Limits are as follows:

| Product Table | Minimum Alternate Density at 60°F, 15°C, or 20°C (kg/m3) |
|:---|:--:|
| Table A - Crude Oil (1980) | 470.4 |
| Table A - Crude Oil (2004) | 470.4 |
| Table B - Refined Products (1980) | 470.4 |
| Table B - Refined Products (2004) | 470.4 |
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | N/A |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | N/A |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (1980) | 714.3 |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (2004) | 714.3 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) | 209.79336 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27-EXT) | 209.79336 |
| Gross | N/A |
| Water (1984) | N/A |
| Water (2003) | N/A |
| Ethylene (1974) | 17.54502 |
| Ethylene (2013) | 17.54502 |
| Propylene (1974) | 404.0047 |
| Butadiene & Concentrates (1994) | 620.388 |
| Aromatics & Cyclohexane (2004) | 651.8379 |
| TP - 2 | 209.79336 |
| COSTALD | 209.79336 |
| Nist-23 | N/A |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C3 | 209.79336 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C4 | 209.79336 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - Nat. Gasoline | 209.79336 |

If the Meter Equipment option ‘Hide no Flow Exceptions’ is checked and the flow data provided is in a <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="No Flow 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />no flow</a> state, then this exception will not be generated.

> A record is considered to be in a no flow state when:
>
> <table class="FcTable" style="margin-left: 0;margin-right: auto;width: 510px;">
> <thead>
> <tr>
> <th style="text-align: center; background-color: #696969; color: #ffffff; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 0px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px;">Record Type</th>

> </tr>
> </thead>
> <tbody>

> <li>Volume = 0; and</li>
> <li>Flow Time or Pulses = 0</li>
> </ul></td>
> </tr>
> <tr>

> <li>Density is 0; and</li>
> <li>Temperature is 0; and</li>
> <li>Pressure is 0; and</li>
> <li>IV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>GSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>NSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>Mass is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>At least one of IV, GSV, NSV and Mass is 0</li>
> </ul></td>
> </tr>
> </tbody>
> </table>

For example, if a Liquid Turbine periodic record is imported with a Product of Propane (Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27)), a non-zero IV, and an Observed Density of 0.2 REL, then this exception will be generated.

0.2 REL converted to kg/m3 is 199.8032 kg/m3, which is below the Alternate Density Lower Limit for a Table E – Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) Product.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01058">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01058">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

If the record is considered a <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Zero Volume 2">

>
> <table class="FcTable" style="margin-left: 0;margin-right: auto;width: 510px;">
> <thead>
> <tr>

> </tr>
> </thead>
> <tbody>
> <tr>
> <td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 0px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; font-weight: normal; background-color: #ffffff;"><p>Liquid volumetric and inferred volume meters</p></td>

> <li>Pulses is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>IV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>GSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>

> </ul></td>
> </tr>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01059">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1059 CV - Cubical expansion factor low for API volume correction equations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01059">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data with a Table C Product.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Cubical Expansion Factor (Alpha) configured on the Product is less than the Alpha Lower Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Alpha Lower Limits are as follows:

| Product Table | Minimum Alpha (1/°F) | Maximum Alpha (1/°C) |
|:---|:--:|:--:|
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | 0.00027 | 0.000486 |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | 0.00023 | 0.000414 |

For example, if a Meter Ticket is imported with a Product of Ethanol (Table C – Special Applications (2004)) that has an Alpha of 0.00026 1/°F, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01060">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1060 CV - Alternate density high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01060">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If an Observed Density value is provided that is greater than the Alternate Density Upper Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Alternate Density Upper Limits are as follows:

| Product Table | Maximum Alternate Density at 60°F, 15°C, or 20°C (kg/m3) |
|:---|:--:|
| Table A - Crude Oil (1980) | 1201.8 |
| Table A - Crude Oil (2004) | 1201.8 |
| Table B - Refined Products (1980) | 1201.8 |
| Table B - Refined Products (2004) | 1201.8 |
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | N/A |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | N/A |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (1980) | 1208.3 |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (2004) | 1208.3 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) | 739.27184 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27-EXT) | 739.27184 |
| Gross | N/A |
| Water (1984) | N/A |
| Water (2003) | N/A |
| Ethylene (1974) | 418.2549 |
| Ethylene (2013) | 418.2549 |
| Propylene (1974) | 567.0826 |
| Butadiene & Concentrates (1994) | 633.376 |
| Aromatics & Cyclohexane (2004) | 927.5036 |
| TP - 2 | 739.27184 |
| COSTALD | 739.27184 |
| Nist-23 | N/A |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C3 | 739.2718 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C4 | 739.2718 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - Nat. Gasoline | 739.2718 |

For example, if a Liquid Turbine periodic record is imported with a Product of Propane (Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27)) and an Observed Density on 0.85 REL, then this exception will be generated.

0.85 REL converted to kg/m3 is 849.1636 kg/m3, which is greater than the Alternate Density Upper Limit for a Table E – Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) Product.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01063">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1063 CV - Cubical expansion factor high for API volume correction equations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01063">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data with a Table C Product.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Cubical Expansion Factor (Alpha) configured on the Product is greater than the Alpha Upper Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Alpha Upper Limits are as follows:

| Product Table | Minimum Alpha (1/°F) | Maximum Alpha (1/°C) |
|:---|:--:|:--:|
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | 0.000486 | 0.001674 |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | 0.000414 | 0.001674 |

For example, if a Meter Ticket is imported with a Product of Ethanol (Table C – Special Applications (2004)) that has an Alpha of 0.00046 1/°F, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

> <td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; background-color: #f5f5f5;"><ul>
> <li>Density is 0; and</li>
> <li>Temperature is 0; and</li>

> <li>GSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>NSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>

> </ul></td>
> </tr>
> </tbody>
> </table>

For example, if a Liquid Turbine periodic record is imported with a Product of Crude (Table A - Crude Oil (2004)) and the Base Density is calculated to be 0.4927 REL, then this exception will be generated.

0.4927 REL converted to kg/m3 is 492.2152 kg/m3, which is below the Density Lower Limit for a Table A - Crude Oil (2004) Product.

> <th style="text-align: center; background-color: #696969; color: #ffffff; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px;">Conditions</th>
> </tr>
> </thead>
> <tbody>
> <tr>
> <td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 0px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; font-weight: normal; background-color: #ffffff;"><p>Liquid volumetric and inferred volume meters</p></td>

> <li>GSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>

> <li>Mass is 0 or undefined</li>

> <li>Differential pressure is 0 or undefined; and</li>

> </ul></td>

For example, if a Liquid Turbine periodic record is imported with a Product of Crude (Table A - Crude Oil (2004)) and the Base Density is calculated to be 1.0765 REL, then this exception will be generated.

1.0765 REL converted to kg/m3 is 1075.4407 kg/m3, which is greater than the Density Upper Limit for a Table A - Crude Oil (2004) Product.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01079">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1079 CV - Late event causing recalc of orig data VCF (ignore only)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01079">

This exception applies to gas meter data.

When an event is imported through Transaction Queue that is within the time frame of a periodic that has previously been imported, and the event change affects the volume, then FLOWCAL will recalculate the VCF and generate this exception.

This exception can only be ignored, not resolved, pending, or acknowledged.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01080">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1080 CV - Late event causing recalc of rev data VCF/volume (ignore only)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01080">

This exception applies to gas meter data.

When an event is imported through Transaction Queue that is within the time frame of a periodic that has previously been imported and has additional revisions, and the event change affects the volume, then FLOWCAL will recalculate the VCF and generate this exception.

This exception can only be ignored, not resolved, pending, or acknowledged.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01081">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1081 CV - System constant for density of air not present</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01081">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data for Coriolis Meters.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If the Density of Air is not configured on the System that the Meter is a member of, then this exception will be generated on each flow data record that is created.

The Density of Air is configured in System Factors (Admin \> System Options \> System Factors).

</div>

#### 1083 CV - Raw volume not present or unable to calculate (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01087">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1087 CV - Flowing density out of validation limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01087">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meters and Tickets.

When the Product option “Run on Imports and Edits” for Density on Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor is enabled, FLOWCAL will compare the imported Meter Flowing Density to the FLOWCAL calculated Meter Density. If the values differ by more than the discrimination set on the Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Crude product using Table A 2004 is configured with a discrimination of 1 for API Deg. If a Meter Flowing Density is imported of 40.5 API and FLOWCAL calculates 40.6 API, then this exception will be generated.

The discrimination for Density units are set on the Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01088">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1088 CV - Base density out of validation limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01088">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meters and Tickets.

When the Product option “Run on Imports and Edits” for Correction Factors on Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor is enabled, FLOWCAL will compare the imported Base Density to the FLOWCAL calculated Base Density. If the values differ by more than the discrimination set on the Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Crude product using Table A 2004 is configured with a discrimination of 4 for Base Density. If a Base Density is imported of 0.99856 and FLOWCAL calculates 0.99854, then this exception will be generated.

The discrimination for Base Density is set on the Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01089">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01089">

When the Product option “Run on Imports and Edits” for Correction Factors on Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor is enabled, FLOWCAL will compare the imported CTL to the FLOWCAL calculated CTL. If the values differ by more than the discrimination set on the Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Crude product using Table A 2004 is configured with a discrimination of 4 for CTL. If a CTL is imported of 0.99856 and FLOWCAL calculates 0.99854, then this exception will be generated.

The discrimination for CTL is set on the Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01090">

When the Product option “Run on Imports and Edits” for Correction Factors on Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor is enabled, FLOWCAL will compare the imported CPL to the FLOWCAL calculated CPL. If the values differ by more than the discrimination set on the Product, then this exception will be generated.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01091">

If the flow data is not Auto Estimated and Meter Flowing Density is less than the Alternate Density Lower Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Alternate Density Lower Limits are as follows:

| Table B - Refined Products (1980) | 470.4 |
| Table B - Refined Products (2004) | 470.4 |
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | N/A |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | N/A |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (1980) | 714.3 |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (2004) | 714.3 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) | 209.79336 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27-EXT) | 209.79336 |
| Gross | N/A |
| Water (1984) | N/A |
| Water (2003) | N/A |
| Ethylene (1974) | 17.54502 |
| Ethylene (2013) | 17.54502 |
| Propylene (1974) | 404.0047 |
| Butadiene & Concentrates (1994) | 620.388 |
| Aromatics & Cyclohexane (2004) | 651.8379 |
| TP - 2 | 209.79336 |
| COSTALD | 209.79336 |
| Nist-23 | N/A |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C3 | 209.79336 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C4 | 209.79336 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - Nat. Gasoline | 209.79336 |

> <li>GSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>
> <li>NSV is 0 or undefined; and</li>

For example, if a Liquid Turbine periodic record is imported with a Product of Crude (Table A - Crude Oil (2004)) and the Meter Flowing Density is calculated to be 0.45 REL, then this exception will be generated.

> <td style="text-align: left; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 0px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; border-right-style: solid; border-right-width: 0px; border-right-color: #c0c0c0; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-top-color: #c0c0c0; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; border-bottom-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; font-weight: normal; background-color: #ffffff;"><p>Orifice and cone meters</p></td>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01099">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

Before performing calculations, FLOWCAL will validate that the data needed for calculations to occur is provided and valid. If an Observed Pressure value is provided that is greater than the Pressure Upper Limit defined for the corresponding Product Table, then this exception will be generated.

The Pressure Upper Limits are as follows:

| Product Table | Maximum Pressure (PSI) |
|:---|:--:|
| Table A - Crude Oil (1980) | 1500 |
| Table A - Crude Oil (2004) | 1500 |
| Table B - Refined Products (1980) | 1500 |
| Table B - Refined Products (2004) | 1500 |
| Table C - Special Applications (1980) | 1500 |
| Table C - Special Applications (2004) | 1500 |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (1980) | 1500 |
| Table D - Lubricating Oils (2004) | 1500 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27) | 1500 |
| Table E - Light Hydrocarbons (TP27-EXT) | 1500 |
| Gross | N/A |
| Water (1984) | 1500 |
| Water (2003) | 1500 |
| Ethylene (1974) | 2500 |
| Ethylene (2013) | 2500 |
| Propylene (1974) | 1600 |
| Butadiene & Concentrates (1994) | 1500 |
| Aromatics & Cyclohexane (2004) | 1500 |
| TP - 2 | 1500 |
| COSTALD | 1500 |
| Nist-23 | N/A |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C3 | 1500 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - C4 | 1500 |
| Table-E (TP-27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density - Nat. Gasoline | 1500 |
